description: Logo show 'ECUAMAN HABLA' v2 - alto contraste, fondo Azul Marino solido

CENTER BELOW TITLE: a cinematic broadcast microphone icon in CELESTE FRESCO hex 7CBFF6 with three radiating sound waves arcs glowing on each side, the microphone head subtly shaped like a stylized shrimp rostrum (saw-edge pico) but unmistakably a microphone. Below microphone: thin horizontal CORAL hex FF6E6E underline accent stroke. BOTTOM CENTER: small letter-spaced caps 'A PODCAST BY ECUANUTRITION' (with ONE 'I' between 'TR' and 'TION', spelled correctly E-C-U-A-N-U-T-R-I-T-I-O-N) in WHITE Figtree Light. Premium broadcast graphic, sharp clean edges, vibrant colors, suitable for YouTube channel art and podcast cover thumbnail. The text MUST be perfectly readable - white on dark navy.
